blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Remasking allows diffusion language models to revisit generated text, but effective correction requires knowing when and what to revise. Our diagnosis on Sudoku reveals two gaps. Hidden states contain error information that token confidence does not reliably expose, and remasking an isolated error usually reproduces it when the surrounding context remains fixed. These findings motivate DiVR , a verifier that predicts whether a partially generated sequence will reach a correct answer. Trained on the final correctness of the model's own trajectories, DiVR decides when to regenerate a block and which alternative to retain, while the generator itself stays unchanged. On five reasoning benchmarks with LLaDA-8B-Base, DiVR raises the average accuracy of the fine-tuned generator from 35.3\% to 43.4\% at $1.9$-$3.5\times$ the cost of greedy decoding, above search baselines that use $3.8$-$7.4\times$. It also complements post-training such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and generalizes to other generators, including Dream.
blocks.zh: 重现允许传播语言模型重温生成的文本,但有效的校正需要知道何时修改和修改什么. 我们对数独的诊断揭示了两个漏洞. 隐藏状态中包含的是无法可靠地显示象征信任的错误信息,当周围上下文仍然固定时,重现一个孤立错误通常会复制它. 这些发现激励了DiVR,一个预测部分生成的序列是否会达到正确答案的验证器. 对模型自身轨迹的最终正确性进行了训练,DiVR决定了何时再生一个块以及保留哪个选项,而生成器本身保持不变. 在LLaDA-8B-Base的五个推理基准上,DiVR将微调生成器的平均精确度从35.3\%提高到43.4\%,比起使用3.8$-7.4\时的搜索基线,贪婪解码的成本为1.9美元-3.5\时. 它还补充了有监督的微调和强化学习等后培训,并向包括Dream在内的其他发电机推广。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) generate text by repeatedly filling in the masked positions of a partially completed canvas, predicting every position with the whole response in view ( Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Nie et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025b ) . This joint generation helps on planning tasks such as Sudoku and Countdown ( Ye et al., 2025a ) , reduces the number of sequential steps ( Inception Labs et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) , and in principle allows generated tokens to be masked again and revised ( Wang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 蒙面扩散语言模型(MDLMs)通过反复填入部分完成的画布所遮盖的姿势来生成文本,用整个反应来预测每个姿势(Sahoo等,2024;Nie等,2025;Ye等,2025b.). 这一联合生成帮助了诸如"数都"和"倒计时"(Ye等,2025a)等规划任务,减少了相继步骤的数量(Inception Labs等,2025;Wu等,2026),原则上允许所生成的道具被再次遮掩并被修改(Wang等,2025).

blocks.en: In practice, standard MDLM decoding never revisits a committed token ( Nie et al., 2025 ) , so a wrong answer committed early with high confidence tends to remain ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Remasking samplers and search methods add revision, but decide what to revise by a schedule, the model’s confidence or likelihood, a planner or prompted self-verification ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2026 ; Peng et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2026 ; Bai et al., 2026 ) , none of which is trained to predict whether the final answer is correct. Learned alternatives act on individual tokens, through scorers trained against a reference sequence, unmasking policies or uniform-noise training ( Kim et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Jazbec et al., 2026 ; von Rütte et al., 2025 ) , although in free-form reasoning a token that departs from the reference may still belong to a correct solution. Others borrow an external process reward model trained on autoregressive solutions ( Mounier and Idehpour, 2025 ; Dang et al., 2026 ; Misaki and Akiba, 2026 ; Miles et al., 2026 ) , a second large model that never sees the generator’s states.
blocks.zh: 在实践中,标准的MDLM解码从不重温承诺的符号(Nie等,2025年),因此早期在高度信心下承诺的错误答案往往会保留(Zhao等,2026年). Remasking采样器和搜索方法会增加修订内容,但决定按时间表修改什么,模型的自信或可能性,规划者或促使自我验证(Wang等,2025;Hong等,2026;Peng等,2025;Luo等,2026;Bai等,2026),均没有经过培训来预测最终答案是否正确. 通过对照参考序列培训的计分员,学会了个人代币的替代物(Kim等,2026年;Huang等,2026年;Zhang等,2026年;Jazbec等,2026年;von Rütte等,2025年),尽管在自由形式推理中,偏离参考物的代币可能仍属于正确的解决方案。 其他人借用了经过自发性解决方案培训的外部过程奖励模型(Munier and Idehpour, 2025; Dang等人, 2026; Misaki and Akiba, 2026; Miles等人, 2026),这是第二个从未见过发电机状态的大模型.

blocks.en: Recent work shows that MDLM hidden states carry correctness information about the sequence as a whole. The final answer is often identifiable before decoding ends ( Li et al., 2026 ) , correct intermediate answers are sometimes overwritten ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , and hidden states predict whether the output will be correct ( Chiu and Liu, 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . It remains open whether this information pinpoints which tokens are wrong, and whether locating an error is enough to repair it.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作显示,MDLM隐藏状态携带了整个序列的正确性信息. 最终答案在解码结束前往往可以被识别(Li等,2026年),正确的中间答案有时会被覆盖(Wang等,2026年),而隐藏状态预测输出是否正确(Chiu和Liu等,2026年;赵等,2026年). 这些信息是否指明了哪些符号是错的,以及找到一个错误是否足以修复错误,目前仍未确定。

blocks.en: We answer both questions on Sudoku, where the unique solution labels every cell, and find two gaps. Error information is present at the level of individual cells, but confidence does not expose it, as a linear probe on hidden states separates wrong cells from correct ones better than confidence does (AUROC 0.838 versus 0.685). Locating an error, in turn, does not repair it. Re-predicting exactly the wrong cells fixes only 6 of 77 failures because the retained context keeps supporting the mistake, and reopening part of the preceding reasoning raises this only to 13. Repair therefore requires revising the context together with the error.
blocks.zh: 我们在数独上回答两个问题,其中独特的解决方案给每个单元格贴上标签,发现两个漏洞. 错误信息存在于单个细胞的层面上,但置信度并没有暴露出来,因为对于隐藏状态的线性探测比置信度更能将错误的细胞与正确细胞区分开来(AUROC 0.838对0.685). 分配错误,反过来又不能修复。 重新精确地预测错误的单元格只纠正了77个失败中的6个,因为保留上下文不断支持错误,重新打开前述推理的一部分只使这个错误上升到了13个. 因此,修复需要修改上下文和错误。

blocks.en: Guided by this diagnosis, we propose DiVR ( Di ffusion V erifier for R egeneration). 1 1 1 Code: https://github.com/minhaeoh/DiVR DiVR shares the generator’s backbone, scores the partially masked canvas after each block, and regenerates the whole block when the score is low, keeping the best-scoring alternative or the original. It is trained only on the generator’s own decodes labelled by final-answer correctness, so it needs answer checks but no token-level labels ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Yu et al., 2024 ) . Our contributions are as follows. • A diagnosis on Sudoku showing that MDLM errors are readable from hidden states but persist when only the erroneous tokens are re-predicted (Section 2 ). • DiVR, an outcome-supervised verifier that shares the generator’s weights and decides when to regenerate a block and which alternative to keep (Section 3 ). • Experiments on five math and code benchmarks and three generators, in which DiVR outperforms the search baselines SR-SMC and Prism at a fraction of their cost, transfers to benchmarks and generators it was not trained on, and adds to supervised and reinforcement-learning post-training. Most of its repairs begin in the first block of a solution, as the diagnosis predicts (Section 4 ).
blocks.zh: 在这种诊断的指导下,我们提出DiVR(用于R egeneration的 Difusion V 校正器)。 DiVR共享生成器的骨干,在每个块后对被遮住的部分画布进行分数,并在分数低时再生出整个块,保留得分最高的替代品或原作. 它只接受以最终答案正确性标记的生成器自身解码的训练,因此它需要回答检查,但没有表示值级标签(Cobbe等,2021;Yu等,2024)。 我们的贡献如下。 二. 支助 对数独的诊断表明,MDLM错误可以从隐藏状态读取,但当只重新预测出错误的符号时,这些错误就继续存在(第2节)。 • DiVR,由结果监督的核查员,分享发电机的重量,并决定何时再生一个区块,以及保留哪些替代办法(第3节)。 • 5个数学和密码基准以及3个发电机的实验,其中DiVR比搜索基线SR-SMC和Prism的功率略高,转而使用没有经过培训的基准和发电机,并增加了监督和强化的后培训。 正如诊断所预测的(第4节),大部分修复工作开始于溶液的第一个区块.

blocks.en: 2 Diagnosis: Readable Errors, Persistent Mistakes
blocks.zh: 2 诊断: 可读错误, 持续的错误

blocks.en: We ask whether an MDLM’s errors are represented in its hidden states, whether its confidence exposes them, and whether reopening an erroneous position repairs it. Sudoku answers these questions with token-level ground truth, because every cell of a uniquely solvable puzzle has exactly one correct digit.
blocks.zh: 我们询问一个MDLM的错误是否在隐藏状态中出现,它的信心是否暴露出来,以及是否重新打开错误的位置修复它. 数独用符号级地面真理来回答这些问题,因为一个独特的可溶解的谜题的每一个单元格都有一个完全正确的数字.

blocks.en: We study LLaDA-8B-Instruct after one epoch of supervised training on Sudoku propagation traces, on the 190 uniquely solvable 4 × 4 4{\times}4 evaluation puzzles of d1 ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) , with a 128-token canvas, 128 steps and temperature zero. We analyze two decoders. Commit-once fills masked positions in confidence order and never changes them, and confidence-based remasking may mask filled positions again, so that the model can revise a committed mistake. Linear probes on answer-position hidden states are compared with confidence, scored as 1 − p top1 1-p_{\mathrm{top1}} , on the same observations (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 我们研究LLaDA-8B-在经过一个时代的有监督的关于微尘传播痕迹的训练后, 研究190个独特的可溶解的 4× 4 4 §times}4 个评价谜题d1(赵等,2025年), 我们分析两个解码器。 交接后按置信顺序填补被遮住的位置而永不改变,基于置信的再伪装可能再次掩盖被填入的位置,这样模型就可以修正一个已承诺的错误. 在答案-位置隐藏状态上的线性探测器被与信心相提并论,得分为1-p上1 1-p-------------------------------------------top1------,在同一观测上(附录A.).

blocks.en: On remasking trajectories, the final-layer probe separates wrong from correct cells with AUROC 0.838 at the final state, against 0.685 for confidence (Figure 1 a). The information is already present when a digit is first chosen. At the forward pass that first fills a cell, while the cell is still masked, the probe reaches 0.866 against 0.732. Commit-once trajectories show the same ordering, and the probe also ranks the wrong cells of a puzzle above its correct ones, so it locates errors rather than only recognizing difficult puzzles.

(b) After re-masking a wrong cell, the original digit stays highly probable and the gold digit rarely outranks it. blocks.en: We mask one committed wrong cell, keep the rest of the canvas, and let the model predict it again. The original wrong digit keeps a mean probability of 0.869, rising to 0.962 when the cell is masked sixteen steps after its commit, and the gold digit rarely outranks it (Figure 1 b). On 77 failed puzzles, a gold oracle that reopens every wrong answer cell repairs only 6 (Figure 1 c). Reopening the reasoning written after the first error as well helps, but the best fixed rollback depth repairs 13, and even the best depth chosen for each puzzle with the gold answer repairs 15.
blocks.zh: 我们掩盖一个错误的细胞, 保存其余的画布, 让模型再次预测它。 原错位数保持了0.869的平均概率,当细胞在犯罪后被遮住16个步骤后会上升至0.962,而金位数则很少比它高(图1b). 在77个失败的谜题上,一个金色的甲骨文只重新打开了每个错误的解答单元格修复6个(图1 c). 重开第一次出错后所写的推理也有帮助,但最好的固定回滚深度修复13,甚至每个谜题选择的最佳深度用金答修复15.

blocks.en: Error information can be read from the model’s states, but re-predicting the erroneous tokens under their context rarely repairs them. Instead of locating an error and fixing it in place, a method should regenerate a region jointly and judge the alternatives by their eventual outcome, which is what DiVR does.
blocks.zh: 错误信息可以从模型的状态读取,但重新预测其上下文下的错误符号很少修复. 一种方法不应该找到一个错误并加以纠正,而应该联合再生一个区域,并根据其最终结果来判断替代品,这是DiVR所做的.

blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Learning an outcome criterion on masked states
blocks.zh: 3.1 学习关于被掩盖状态的结果标准

blocks.en: The diagnosis motivates two design choices. The criterion for revision should be learned rather than read from token confidence, and the unit of revision should be a region regenerated jointly rather than an isolated token. DiVR implements both with an outcome-supervised verifier and block re-decoding, as Figure 2 illustrates.
blocks.zh: 诊断激励了两种设计选择. 修订标准应当学习,而不是从象征性的信任中读取,修订单位应当是一个共同产生的区域,而不是孤立的象征。 如图2所示,DiVR同时执行结果监督验证器和块重解码.

blocks.en: 3.3 Classification and within-question ranking
blocks.zh: 3.3 分类和问题内部排名

blocks.en: Each training step draws one question and one block index b b and forms the state s i , b s_{i,b} of each of its four sampled trajectories, using the final boundary of a trajectory that ended earlier. blocks.en: 3.4 Selection and block re-decoding
blocks.zh: 3.4 选择和块重解码

blocks.en: For best-of- k k , the generator samples k k complete responses, and we return the one whose final state scores highest. For guided decoding, the generator fills each block in its ordinary way and the verifier scores the canvas. If the score is below θ \theta and the regeneration budget is not exhausted, we remask the whole block, sample K K alternatives from the same prefix, and keep the original unless an alternative scores higher. Decoding then continues, and every regeneration event counts against the budget. Because the whole block is resampled, its tokens change together, as the diagnosis requires, and the procedure needs neither to locate the error nor to know what caused it.
blocks.zh: 对于最好的Kk, 发电机样本Kk完成反应, 我们返回一个其最终状态得分最高的。 对于被引导的解码,生成器会以普通的方式填充每个块,而验证器会给画布打分. 如果得分低于\\theta,且再生预算没有用完,我们重新覆盖整块,从同名前缀中抽取K K 替代品,并保留原作,除非替代得分更高. 然后继续解码,每起再生事件都与预算无关。 因为整块被重新标出,它的符号按照诊断要求一起变化,程序既不需要定位出错,也不需要知道出错的原因.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental setup and baselines
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置和基线

blocks.en: We evaluate three models, LLaDA-8B-Base and LLaDA-8B-Instruct ( Nie et al., 2025 ) and Dream-v0-Instruct-7B ( Ye et al., 2025b ) . LLaDA-8B-Base is evaluated both untuned (Base) and after supervised fine-tuning on GSM8K (SFT). The instruction-tuned models are used as released, and Appendix Table 6 reports them after the same fine-tuning. We use three math benchmarks, GSM8K (1,319 problems) ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , MATH-500 (500) ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Lightman et al., 2024 ) and Countdown (500 three-number tasks) ( Pan et al., 2025 ) , and two code benchmarks, HumanEval (164) ( Chen et al., 2021 ) and MBPP (500) ( Austin et al., 2021 ) , and report their unweighted average. The prompts are listed in Appendix G . Each generator has one verifier per domain, trained on four of its own responses, sampled at temperature 0.7, for each of 2,000 GSM8K training questions for math and for each MBPP training and validation problem for code. A verifier serves every benchmark of its domain, and the untuned Base model is guided by the SFT generator’s verifiers. The epoch and the threshold θ \theta are chosen on development data, and the remaining hyperparameters are given in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们评价了三种模式,即LLaDA-8B-Base和LLaDA-8B-Instructiont(Nie等,2025年)和Dream-v0-Instructiont-7B(Ye等,2025年b). LLaDA-8B-Base既未经调整(Base),也经过监督地对GSM8K(SFT)进行微调后进行评价。 指导调制的模型作为发布使用,附录表6在同样的微调后报告. 我们使用三个数学基准,GSM8K(1,319个问题) (Cobbe等,2021年),MATH-500(500)(Hendrycks等,2021年;Lightman等,2024年)和倒计时(500个三数任务)(Pan等,2025年),和两个代码基准HumanEval(164)(Chen等,2021年)和MBPP(500)(Austin等,2021年),并报告其未加权平均值. 这些提示列于附录G。 每个生成器每个域都有1个核查器,训练有4个自己的答复,在0.7温度下取样,每个2 000个GSM8K数学培训问题和每个MBPP培训和验证问题。 一个核查员服务于其域内的每一个基准,未经调整的基础模型由SFT生成器的核查员指导. 在开发数据上选择了时代和门槛 \\theta,其余的超参数见附录B。

blocks.en: Canvases contain 256 tokens, or 512 for MATH-500, decoded in 32-token blocks with 16 steps per block. Guided decoding uses θ = 0.5 \theta=0.5 and K = 4 K=4 alternatives at temperature 0.7, with at most three regeneration events per problem. Cost counts forward passes, verifier reads included, relative to a greedy decode of the same problems, which is also the reference for accuracy. We compare against two search methods for diffusion decoding, reimplemented on the same generators and decoder (Appendix C ). SR-SMC ( Luo et al., 2026 ) keeps four particles and resamples them after each block by their accumulated log-confidence, and Prism ( Bai et al., 2026 ) starts sixteen trajectories, prunes them to four with the generator’s own prompted Yes/No judgment, and answers by majority vote, as in its paper (Appendix Table 5 reports its released top-score rule). Both search with the generator’s own judgment and keep several trajectories for every problem, whereas guided decoding branches only at flagged blocks. DiVR best-of-4 reranks four complete samples by the verifier’s score at about the baselines’ budget, which isolates the verifier’s selection quality from block regeneration.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes the results. Across the three generators, guided decoding is the most accurate method on average for every generator, and with best-of-4, which uses about the search baselines’ budget, DiVR is the most accurate on every math and code benchmark. On the SFT generator, guided decoding raises GSM8K from 68.7% to 78.8% and MBPP from 24.2% to 33.6%, and best-of-4 raises GSM8K further to 82.2%. On GSM8K with the SFT generator, guided decoding is also more accurate than the search baselines at a lower cost, reaching 78.8% at 2.1 × 2.1\times the cost of greedy decoding against 72.6% at 4.0 × 4.0\times for SR-SMC and 71.9% at 5.9 × 5.9\times for Prism. On LLaDA-8B-Instruct, guided decoding raises the five-benchmark average from 39.4% to 44.8%, and best-of-4 reaches 49.8%, 10.4 points above greedy decoding. These results show that DiVR is an effective inference-time revision method for MDLMs.

blocks.en: Over the five benchmarks of the SFT generator, guided decoding raises the average from 35.3% to 43.4% at 1.9 1.9 – 3.5 × 3.5\times the cost of greedy decoding, whereas SR-SMC reaches 39.1% at 3.8 3.8 – 4.0 × 4.0\times and Prism 37.3% at 5.2 5.2 – 7.4 × 7.4\times . On average, guided decoding thus uses about 70% of SR-SMC’s computation and less than half of Prism’s. Best-of-4 with the same verifier is the most accurate row on most benchmarks, and guided decoding comes close to it at as little as 40% of its cost. Guided decoding retains most of the gain of best-of-4 because it samples alternatives only for the blocks the verifier flags, which Table 2 shows to be concentrated at the start of a solution. The gap between the two DiVR rows is small next to the gap between either of them and the baselines, so the benefit comes from the verifier’s judgment rather than from the amount of sampling.

blocks.en: We test whether DiVR adds to post-training of the generator on two post-trained variants, supervised fine-tuning of LLaDA-8B-Base and diffu-GRPO reinforcement learning of LLaDA-8B-Instruct, the model for which d1 published its recipe ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) , trained at about one eighth of d1’s GSM8K budget. DiVR improves both. Fine-tuning raises Countdown from 10.6% to 35.6%, and guided decoding raises it further to 47.2%. For the RL generator, guided decoding raises the five-benchmark average from 40.1% to 45.4%. RL training moved the Instruct run’s reward, with its correctness term rising from 0.76 to 1.35 of a possible 2, but greedy accuracy moved little (the rows marked ‡ \ddagger ). With guidance, the RL generator gains 6.0 points on GSM8K and 11.2 on Countdown over its own greedy decoding, more than the verifier adds to Instruct itself (3.8 and 7.4). RL changes what the generator writes, the verifier decides when a block is discarded, and the two gains add. Appendix Table 7 gives the training details.
blocks.zh: 我们测试DiVR是否在发电机的后培训中加入两个经过培训的变体, 监督微调LLaDA-8B-Base, DiVR改进了两者. 微调将倒计时率从10.6%提高到35.6%,并引导解码进一步提高到47.2%. 对RL生成器来说,导出解码将5个基准的平均值从40.1%提高到45.4%. RL训练将指示跑的奖励感动了起来,其正确性期限从可能的2分的0.76分提高到1.35分,但贪婪的准确性移动得很少(这行标有 \\ ddagger ). 在引导下,RL生成器在GSM8K上获得6.0分,倒计时上获得11.2分,超过核查器在"指针"本身上增加的(3.8分和7.4分). RL会改变生成者所写的,验证者决定一个块何时被丢弃,两个增益会增加. 附录表7提供了培训的详细情况。

blocks.en: Each verifier is trained on a single benchmark per domain, GSM8K for math and MBPP for code, yet it also improves benchmarks it never saw. The GSM8K-trained verifier raises the SFT generator on MATH-500 from 24.6% to 33.8% and on Countdown from 35.6% to 47.2%, and the MBPP-trained verifier raises HumanEval, which has no training split, for LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream (34.1% to 39.0% and 45.1% to 53.0%) (Appendix Table 8 compares the math and code verifiers on code). The verifiers also transfer across generators. Without any training on the untuned Base model’s decodes, the SFT generator’s verifiers raise its average from 29.3% to 38.0%, above the 35.3% of fine-tuning alone. Trained on its own decodes, the same recipe raises Dream-v0-Instruct-7B, a second model family with a different tokenizer, from 45.0% to 54.8%. The gains are largest where the generator’s own signals are least reliable, as on Countdown, where Dream’s accuracy doubles from 18.0% to 37.2%.
blocks.zh: 每个核查员每个域都接受单一基准的培训,GSM8K用于数学,MBPP用于代码,然而它也改善了从未见过的基准. GSM8K训练的验证器将MATH-500上的SFT生成器由24.6%提升到33.8%,倒计时上的SFT生成器由35.6%提升到47.2%,MBPP训练的验证器将LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream(34.1%提升到39.0%,45.1%提升到53.0%)的HumanEval(附录表8比较了代码上的数学和代码验证器)提升到没有训练分. 核查员也跨越发电机。 SFT生成器的校验器在未调整的Base模型解码方面没有任何训练,平均从29.3%提高到38.0%,高于35.3%的微调。 受自发解码训练,同种配方将Dream-v0-Instruct-7B,第二模范家庭,有不同的活化剂,从45.0%提高到54.8%. 如果发电机本身的信号最不可靠,收益最大,如倒计时,梦的准确度从18.0%翻倍到37.2%。

blocks.en: To see where DiVR triggers the regenerations that repair an answer, we locate the repairs on the three math benchmarks. For every problem that greedy decoding gets wrong and guided decoding gets right, we record the block at which an alternative first replaced the original, which is where the guided trajectory departs from the greedy one. As Table 2 shows, the repairs are concentrated at the start of the solution. On GSM8K, 74% of the 154 repaired problems depart in the first block and 92% within the first two. On Countdown, 58 of the 59 repairs start in the first block, because the generator writes its whole candidate expression there and the next block only copies it into the answer. Appendix F shows three such repairs.
blocks.zh: 查看DiVR触发的再生 修复一个答案, 我们定位修复 在三个数学基准。 对于每一个贪婪的解码错误和被引导的解码正确的问题,我们记录一个替代物首先取代了原作的块,这就是被引导的轨迹偏离了贪婪者. 如表2所示,修复工作集中在解决方案开始时。 在GSM8K上,154个被修复的问题中,有74%在第一个街区出发,92%在前两个街区出发. 在倒计时时,59个修补中的58个在第一个区块开始,因为发电机将它的全部候选表达写在那里,下一个区块只复制到答案中. 附 录 F显示了三次这样的修复.

blocks.en: This concentration has two sources, and the table separates them. The first is detection. Among greedy decodes, the first-block score falls below θ \theta for 76% of the eventually wrong GSM8K solutions and 22% of the eventually right ones, for 99% and 1% on Countdown, and for 50% and 14% on MATH-500. One block is therefore enough for the verifier to separate most trajectories by their eventual outcome. The second source is repairability, which the diagnosis predicted. The first block fixes the interpretation of the problem, such as which quantity is asked for or how the equation is set up, and later tokens are predicted from that context and tend to confirm it. A fresh sample of the first block starts from the prompt alone and can take a different route, whereas a fresh sample of a later block inherits the mistaken setup.
blocks.zh: 这种集中有两个来源,表格将它们分开. 第一是探测 在贪婪的解码器中,第一个街区得分低于\\theta,最终76%的GSM8K解码器错误,22%的解码器最终正确,99%和1%在倒计时,50%和14%在MATH-500. 因此,一个区块足以使核查者按照最终结果将大多数轨迹分开。 第二个来源是可修复性,这是诊断所预测的. 第一个区块固定了对问题的诠释,例如要求的是多少数量还是如何设置等式,后来的指使会从上下文来预测并倾向于确认. 第一个区块的新样本单从快取开始,可以走不同的路线,而后一个区块的新样本继承了错误的设置.

blocks.zh: 5 分析

blocks.en: The main results combine a learned score with a regeneration procedure, so we first ask whether the improvement comes from the verifier or from the opportunity to regenerate. On GSM8K with the SFT generator, we hold the regeneration procedure and its budget fixed and replace only the signal that decides when to regenerate and which block to keep. As shown in Table 3 , three signals serve as controls. Commitment confidence is the geometric mean of the probabilities with which the visible tokens were placed, the signal on which confidence-based remasking relies. Prompted Yes/No asks the generator itself, through a judgment prompt, whether the partial solution is correct, the signal that Prism uses to prune its search. A head-only verifier (V0) is DiVR without its adapter, so its head is trained with the same outcome labels on the generator’s unchanged hidden states. Each signal uses the threshold that maximizes its accuracy on the development split.

blocks.en: The ordering of the signals mirrors the diagnosis. Confidence and self-judgment reach 72.2% and 67.9%, so regenerating on the generator’s own signals recovers a small part of the gain over the 68.7% of greedy decoding or none of it. The head-only verifier reaches 74.2%, so an outcome-trained score helps even on the generator’s unchanged states. The full verifier reaches 78.8% at the lowest cost, 2.10 × 2.10\times against 2.45 2.45 – 3.62 × 3.62\times , which is consistent with a sharper signal spending fewer regeneration events on blocks that were already adequate. The improvement therefore comes from the verifier’s learned criterion. The gap between the head-only verifier and DiVR also shows that reshaping the representation with the adapter, so that the outcome information is easier to use, matters.
blocks.zh: 信号的顺序 反映了诊断。 信心和自我判断达到72.2%和67.9%,因此在发电机自身的信号上再生可以恢复比68.7%的贪婪解码或无此收益的一小部分。 仅限头部验证器达到74.2%,因此,结果训练分数甚至有助于生成器的状态不变。 完全验证器的成本最低,达到78.8%,2.10×2.10分,而245/45×3.62分,3.62分,这与在已经足够多的区块上花费较少再生事件的更尖锐信号是一致的。 因此,改进来自核查者所学到的标准。 只头验证器与DiVR之间的空隙也表明,用适配器重塑代表,使结果信息更容易被使用,这一点很重要.

DiVR exceeds majority voting on GSM8K (82.2% against 75.7%), MATH-500 (34.2% against 28.8%) and Countdown (49.2% against 38.2%). Mean log-probability reaches only 68.5%, 23.6% and 34.6%, close to picking a candidate uniformly at random (68.7%, 24.6% and 33.7%), so the generator’s likelihood carries almost no information about which of its own samples is correct. blocks.en: Guiding decoding requires a score that ranks partial solutions, not only finished ones. On the same candidates, DiVR’s pair accuracy on GSM8K is already 0.705 after the first block and rises to 0.919 for the finished responses, and on Countdown it reaches 0.957 after the first block (Table 4 ). Useful discrimination thus appears after the first block, where most repairs begin (Table 2 ).

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: MDLMs can revise intermediate states during iterative unmasking ( Nie et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025b ) . ReMDM remasks generated tokens to spend additional inference computation on refinement ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and PRISM learns token-quality estimates to choose which positions to remask ( Kim et al., 2026 ) . Search methods weight and resample trajectories by their accumulated log-probabilities ( Luo et al., 2026 ) or prune them with prompted self-verification ( Bai et al., 2026 ) . Others bring an external process reward model into diffusion decoding to remask low-scoring blocks ( Mounier and Idehpour, 2025 ) , resample particles ( Dang et al., 2026 ) , guide a tree search over unmasking actions ( Misaki and Akiba, 2026 ) or stitch high-scoring steps across traces ( Miles et al., 2026 ) . Reinforcement learning with outcome or denoising-process rewards also improves reasoning in these models ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) , and Section 4 shows that DiVR’s gains add to d1’s recipe. DiVR differs from these methods in its signal, an outcome criterion learned on the generator’s own partially masked states.
blocks.zh: MDLMs可以在迭代解析时修改中间态(Nie等,2025;Ye等,2025b.). ReMDM remasks 生成了将额外推论计算用于精炼的符号(Wang等,2025年),而PRISM 学习了符号质量的估算,以选择哪些位置来进行再测(Kim等,2026年). 搜索方法重量和再模拟轨迹,按其累积的对数概率(Luo等,2026年)或按所激发的自我核查进行推算(Bai等,2026年)。 其他人则将一个外部过程奖励模型引入了传播解码,以重塑低分数块(Munier and Idehpour, 2025),再生颗粒(Dang等, 2026),引导树上搜索出出假动作(Misaki and Akiba, 2026),或缝接高分数步跨出痕迹(Miles等, 2026). 强化学习的结果或解密过程奖励也改进了这些模型的推理(赵等,2025;谢等,2026),而第4节显示,DiVR的收益增加了d1的食谱. DiVR在信号中不同于这些方法,

blocks.en: In autoregressive LLMs, hidden states encode the correctness of outputs beyond what output probabilities reveal ( Orgad et al., 2025 ) . For MDLMs, corrective post-training supervises incorrect tokens directly so that confidence-guided refinement targets them ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , linear probes on hidden states predict whether the final output will be correct ( Chiu and Liu, 2026 ) , and LOCKR detects answers that settle early on a wrong value from hidden-state trajectories and repairs them by remasking an answer region ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Concurrently, Zhan et al. (2026) train a verifier of a similar form, a LoRA-adapted MDLM backbone with an MLP head, and use it to prune candidates at every scoring step. Our work differs in three respects. Our diagnosis shows that a correctly located error is rarely repaired while its context is kept, which motivates regenerating whole blocks rather than answer tokens. Our verifier triggers regeneration only below a threshold and keeps the original block unless an alternative scores higher. Finally, we evaluate one procedure across three generators and five math and code benchmarks against confidence, self-verification and search baselines.
blocks.zh: 在自动递归的LLMs中,隐藏状态编码了输出概率所揭示的输出的正确性(Orgad等,2025年)。 对于MDLM,修正后训练直接监督不正确的符号,使信心引导的完善针对它们(Zhang等,2026年),隐藏状态的线性探测器预测出最终输出是否正确(Chiu和Liu,2026年),LOCKR检测到从隐藏状态轨迹中提早解决错误值的答案,并通过重现一个答案区域来进行修复(Zhao等,2026年). 同时 Zhan等人(2026年)培养出一个类似形态的验证员,一个LORA所适应的MDLM骨干,并有MLP头,在每分分出一分时都用它来给考生分分. 我们的工作在三个方面有所不同。 我们的诊断表明,一个正确位置的错误在保存上下文的同时很少被修复,这激励着整个块的再生,而不是回答符号. 我们的核查员触发的再生只低于一个阈值,并且保持原来的块,除非一个替代的得分更高. 最后,我们对照信心、自我核查和搜索基线,对三个发电机和五个数学和密码基准进行一项评估。

blocks.en: Cobbe et al. (2021) train verifiers on sampled solutions labelled by final-answer correctness and use them to select among candidates, and process supervision labels individual steps instead ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) . Outcome labels also support evaluating partial solutions, through values learned for step-level planning ( Yu et al., 2024 ) or process rewards derived from outcome supervision ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) , and verifiers can steer generation before a solution is complete ( Liao et al., 2025 ) . For masked diffusion outside text, MDM-VGB regresses a verifier of masked states onto the terminal rewards of the model’s own rollouts to guide unmasking and remasking ( Jeon et al., 2026 ) . DiVR brings such a state evaluator to partially masked text, trained on the generator’s own decodes instead of a reward model trained on complete solutions, and uses it to decide block regeneration.
blocks.zh: Cobbe等人(2021年)在以最终回答正确性为标签的抽样解决方案上进行培训核查员,并用他们来在候选人中进行选择,过程监督标记为个别步骤取而代之(Lightman等人,2024年). 结果标签还支持评价部分解决办法,方法是通过为分级规划(Yu等人,2024年)或从结果监督(Yuan等人,2025年)中获得的流程奖励所学到的数值,而且核查者可以在解决方案完成之前指导生成(Liao等人,2025年)。 MDM-VGB将蒙面状态的验证器退到模型自己推出的终端奖品上, DiVR将这样的状态评价员带入了被遮盖的部分文字,训练了生成器自己的解码,而不是训练了完整的解决方案的奖励模型,并利用它来决定块再生.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Our diagnosis shows that an MDLM can carry information about its errors and still fail to repair them in place, because the surrounding context keeps reproducing the mistake. DiVR therefore decides when a block should be written again, using a verifier learned from the generator’s own outcomes. This single decision, made after each block, improves three generators on five math and code benchmarks, outperforms search at a fraction of its cost, and adds to supervised and reinforcement-learning post-training. Revision in MDLMs needs a learned criterion of when to start over more than a way to find the error.
blocks.zh: 我们的诊断表明,MDLM可以携带有关其错误的信息,但仍然无法修复,因为周围的环境不断重复错误. 因此,DiVR使用从生成器自身结果中吸取的验证器来决定何时应该再次写入块. 在每个区块之后作出的这项单一决定,改进了五个数学和代码基准上的三台发电机,以成本的一小部分完成了搜索,并增加了有监督的和强化的后培训。 在 MDLMs 中修订需要一个学习到的标准,即何时从更多角度开始,而不是找到错误的方法.

blocks.en: The primary verifier uses four samples for each of 2,000 GSM8K training questions, decoded with the canvas, block length and step schedule of the main experiments. Every verifier uses a rank-32 adapter with scaling α = 64 \alpha=64 on the attention and feed-forward projections, and its head maps the hidden dimension through 1,024 SiLU units to a single logit. Training runs for two epochs with gradients accumulated over four questions. It pools the full response canvas, including unresolved masks. An already-terminated sample contributes its final boundary when a later training index is drawn. For the SFT generator, the SFT adapter is merged into the backbone before the verifier adapter is added, so that disabling the verifier adapter leaves exactly the SFT generator. Pair accuracy averages correct–incorrect ranking accuracy within each problem, then across problems with both outcomes, and ties receive half credit. After block b b , a candidate that has already terminated contributes its final state, and 488 of the 1,319 GSM8K test problems have both outcomes among their four candidates. For each guided run, the paired greedy baseline uses the same process and decoding configuration. Cost counts forward passes weighted by batch rows.

blocks.en: The primary GSM8K run fixes 154 failures and breaks 20 correct answers. Changing only the verifier-training seed gives 77.5% success, and changing only the re-decoding seed gives 77.6%, against 78.8% in the primary run and 68.7% for paired greedy decoding. These are separate sensitivity checks rather than independent end-to-end replications.
blocks.zh: 主要GSM8K运行修正了154个故障并打破了20个正确的答案. 只有修饰者训练出品的种子才有77.5%的成功率,只有修饰出品的种子才有77.6%的成功率,而在初赛中则有78.8%的成功率,而配对的贪婪解码则有68.7%的成功率. 这些是单独的敏感性检查,而不是独立的端到端复制.

blocks.en: MATH-500 is the 500-problem subset of MATH used in process-verification research ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Lightman et al., 2024 ) , and the implementation loads its public dataset release. For Countdown, the sampler filters three-number tasks from the training partition of the public Countdown-Tasks-3to4 collection ( Pan et al., 2025 ) and selects 500 for evaluation.
blocks.zh: MATH-500是用于过程核查研究的MATH的500个问题子集(Hendrycks等,2021;Lightman等,2024),执行中加载了其公共数据集发布. 对于倒计时,采样者从公共倒计时-任务-3to4集(Pan等,2025年)的训练分区中过滤出3个数的任务,并选择500进行评价.

blocks.en: The code results use all 500 MBPP test tasks and 164 HumanEval tasks. MBPP prompts expose the same tests used by its grader. HumanEval runs its test harness on the prompt and extracted program. Programs have a 10-second timeout and a 2-GiB address-space limit, and extraction or execution failures count as incorrect.
blocks.zh: 代码结果使用所有的500 MBPP测试任务和164 HumanEval任务. MBPP提示暴露出其分级器使用的相同测试. HumanEval在即时和被取出的程序上运行它的测试控制. 程序有10秒的超时和2-GiB地址-空格限制,取出或执行失败算作不正确.

blocks.en: The repair block of Table 2 is the first block at which the guided decode’s recorded score departs from the paired greedy decode’s, which identifies the first accepted alternative exactly.
blocks.zh: 表2的修复区块是引导解码记录的分数偏离对等贪婪解码区块的第一个区块,该区块准确地确定了第一个被接受的替代方案。

blocks.en: Appendix C Baselines
blocks.zh: 附录C 基线

blocks.en: SR-SMC is a local blockwise implementation with four particles at temperature 1.0, resampled after a block when the effective sample size falls below two, with the answer taken from the particle of highest total commitment log-confidence.
blocks.zh: SR-SMC是局部的分块执行,温度为1.0时有4个颗粒,当有效样本大小低于2个后被一个块重印出,答案取自最高总承诺日志自信的颗粒.

blocks.en: The Prism port keeps the paper’s hierarchical search, self-verified pruning and remasking. • Search. Sixteen initial trajectories are pruned to K = 4 K{=}4 within the first block’s 10–60% step window, every three steps (decay 1.8). Two survivors branch with two low-confidence tokens remasked. The generator’s own Yes/No judgment scores the trajectories. • Answer. As in the main results of Bai et al. (2026) (their Algorithm 1), the answer is a majority vote over the K K final trajectories, for every benchmark including code. The released code instead returns the final trajectory with the highest judgment score, and Table 5 reports that variant. • Cost. Rows count every judgment read used for pruning. The final judgment reads that the vote does not need are excluded.
blocks.zh: 棱镜口保留了纸的分级搜索,自我验证的穿行和再现. · 搜索. 16个起步轨迹被推到K = 4 K{=}4在第一个区块的10-60%的步道窗口内,每3个步道(第1.8节). 两个幸存者的分会 带着两个低自信的标志 重现。 发电机本身的“是/否”评分。 • 回答。 与Bai等人(2026年)(他们的算法1)的主要结果一样,答案是对K K最终轨迹的多数投票,每个基准包括代码. 所发行的代码则返回了评分最高的最终轨迹,而表5则报告了该变体. • 成本:行数为用于打压的判断。 最后判决指出,不需要排除表决。

blocks.en: Search. Sixteen initial trajectories are pruned to K = 4 K{=}4 within the first block’s 10–60% step window, every three steps (decay 1.8). Two survivors branch with two low-confidence tokens remasked. The generator’s own Yes/No judgment scores the trajectories.
blocks.zh: 寻取. 16个初始轨迹被推到K = 4 K = 4 在第一个区块的10-60%的步道窗口内,每3个步道(第1.8节). 两个幸存者的分会 带着两个低自信的标志 重现。 发电机本身的“是/否”评分。

blocks.en: Answer. As in the main results of Bai et al. (2026) (their Algorithm 1), the answer is a majority vote over the K K final trajectories, for every benchmark including code. The released code instead returns the final trajectory with the highest judgment score, and Table 5 reports that variant.
blocks.zh: 答问. 与Bai等人(2026年)(他们的算法1)的主要结果一样,答案是对K K最终轨迹的多数投票,每个基准包括代码. 所发行的代码则返回了评分最高的最终轨迹,而表5则报告了该变体.

blocks.en: Cost. Rows count every judgment read used for pruning. The final judgment reads that the vote does not need are excluded.
blocks.zh: 成本,行数每个判断 用于跑步。 最后判决指出,不需要排除表决。

blocks.en: Table 5: Prism answer selection. Vote is the majority over the final trajectories, as in Bai et al. (2026) , and is the number in Table 1 . Top is the released code’s choice, the trajectory with the highest self-verification score. Cost is that of the vote, including every pruning judgment.
blocks.zh: 表5:棱镜回答选择. 同Bai等人(2026年)一样,投票占最终路线的多数,也是表1中的数字。 顶部是发布代码的选择,即自我核查分数最高的轨迹. 费用是投票费用,包括每一项判决。

blocks.en: Commitment confidence is the geometric mean of token probabilities recorded when the visible tokens were placed. Prompted self-verification uses the same generator, a judgment prompt and a masked readout position, scoring Yes against No token variants. Each signal’s threshold maximizes accuracy on its 252-problem development evaluation, namely 0.85 for confidence, 0.98 for Yes/No, 0.7 for V0, and 0.5 for DiVR. All test runs cover 1,319 GSM8K problems.
blocks.zh: 承诺置信度是显信度被放出时记录的表示概率的几何平均值. 即时自我核查使用同一个生成器、一个判断即时器和一个被蒙住的读出位置,对无符号变体进行评分。 每个信号的阈值使252个问题的发展评价的准确性最大化,即:信心0.85;是/否0.98;V00.7;DiVR0.5。 所有测试运行覆盖了1,319个GSM8K问题.

blocks.en: The completed mean-log-probability selector re-reads samples with their response tokens visible, so it is not a normalized joint sequence likelihood. Countdown majority voting groups boxed expressions after whitespace removal rather than by their value, which would merge distinct expressions.
blocks.zh: 所完成的中-日志概率选择器用其反应符号可见来重新读取样本,因此它不是一个常态化的联合序列可能性. 倒计时多数投票组在去除白空后,而不是按其价值,将不同的表达式合并.

blocks.en: Appendix D Additional Generators and Verifiers
blocks.zh: 附录D 其他发电机和核证器

blocks.en: Table 6: GSM8K SFT of the instruction-tuned generators. Same SFT data and recipe as the LLaDA-8B-Base SFT generator, each with a verifier trained on its own decodes. All verifiers here are GSM8K-trained, code columns included.
blocks.zh: 表6:调制发电机的GSM8K SFT。 与LLaDA-8B-Base SFT生成器相同的SFT数据和配方,每台都有经过自身解码培训的验证器. 这里所有的核查员都是经过GSM8K训练的,包含代码列.

blocks.en: Table 6 applies the LLaDA-8B-Base SFT recipe unchanged to LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-v0-Instruct-7B (for Dream, the loss reads each position’s prediction from the previous output, matching its decoding convention). SFT lowers both generators. GSM8K greedy accuracy falls from 79.2% to 74.7% for Instruct and from 77.3% to 67.1% for Dream, and the responses shorten, consistent with imitation of the shorter reference solutions. Guidance with each SFT generator’s own verifier brings it to within 1.8 points of the released greedy accuracy or above it on nine of the ten generator–benchmark pairs (the exception is Instruct on HumanEval), but the released generator with its verifier stays ahead on all five benchmarks for Dream and on four of five for Instruct, where only Countdown favors the SFT generator (42.2% against 23.0%). Table 1 therefore uses the released checkpoints for these two generators.
blocks.zh: 表6将LLaDA-8B-Base SFT配方适用于LLaDA-8B-指令和Dream-v0-指令7B(对于Dream,损失读取了上一个产出对每个位置的预测,与其解码公约相匹配)。 SFT降低了两个发电机. GSM8K贪取精度从79.2%下降到74.7%,而Dream则从77.3%下降到67.1%,回复时间也缩短了,与模拟更短的参考解决方案一致. 使用每个 SFT 生成器自己的验证器的指引使其在释放出贪婪的精度的1.8分以内,或者在10个生成器-基准对中的9个之上(例外是HumanEval上的指令),但释放出的具有验证器的生成器在"梦"的所有5个基准和"指令"的5个基准上都保持领先,其中只有倒计时器偏向于SFT生成器(42.2%对23.0%). 因此,表1对这两台发电机使用了已放行的检查站。

blocks.en: Table 7: diffu-GRPO generators under every method. LLaDA-8B-Instruct and the untuned LLaDA-8B-Base after 3,800 steps of d1’s diffu-GRPO recipe on GSM8K, each with DiVR verifiers trained on its own decodes. The greedy rows of the untrained generators repeat Table 1 . † Local reimplementations.
blocks.zh: 表7:各种方法下的diffu-GRPO发电机。 LLaDA-8B-Instruct和未调试的LLaDA-8B-Base在GSM8K上的3800步d1的diffu-GRPO配方后,各有DiVR验证器进行自发解码培训. 未经过训练的发电机的贪婪行重复了表1 . .

blocks.en: The Instruct RL generator of Tables 1 and 7 is LLaDA-8B-Instruct trained with d1’s released diffu-GRPO code and GSM8K reward functions ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) , with LoRA rank 128 ( α = 64 \alpha{=}64 , dropout 0.05) on the attention and feed-forward projections over a 4-bit base, six generations per prompt at temperature 0.9, 256-token completions in blocks of 32 with 128 diffusion steps, twelve inner updates per batch, learning rate 3 × 10 − 6 3\times 10^{-6} , KL coefficient 0.04, clipping 0.5, seed 42, and 3,800 optimizer steps with one prompt per GPU and no gradient accumulation on four RTX A6000 GPUs (12.0 hours). d1 trains its GSM8K model for 7,700 steps on eight A100 GPUs with two accumulation steps, so our training uses about one eighth as many generations, and its correctness reward was still rising slowly at the end.
blocks.zh: 表1和表7的RL生成器是LLaDA-8B-指示器,训练有d1发布的diffu-GROPO代码和GSM8K奖励功能(赵等,2025年),LORA在4位基数的注意力和反馈预测上排出128位(α=64\alpha{=}64,辍学0.05),每位基数为0.9分速速六代,分32个基数的完成分数为256分,每批有128个传播步骤,12个内更新数,学习率为3×10−6/3xtimes 10^{-6},KL系数为0.04分,剪接0.5分,种子为42分,3 800个最优化步骤,每个基数为1分速分,四个RTX A6000GPU无梯度累积(12.0小时)。 d1在八台A100GPU上为7700步训练出它的GSM8K型号,并有两台积分步骤,因此我们的训练使用大约八分之一的代数,其正确性奖励在最后仍然缓慢地上升.

blocks.en: Greedy accuracy. With the single-problem greedy decoder used for the released checkpoints, the trained generator scores 78.8%, 36.4% and 18.8% on GSM8K, MATH-500 and Countdown against 78.5%, 35.6% and 17.6% for Instruct ( p = 0.84 p=0.84 , 0.76 0.76 and 0.66 0.66 ). In the paired decoder of the guided runs it scores 77.4%, 39.4% and 17.0% against 79.2%, 35.0% and 15.6% (Table 7 ). The two greedy decoders differ by up to 3.0 points on MATH-500 for the same adapter, which is why every comparison in this paper is paired within one decoder.
blocks.zh: 贪取精进. 由于对已放行的检查站使用单问题贪婪的解码器,经过培训的发电机在GSM8K、MATH-500和倒计时的分数分别为78.5%、35.6%和17.6%(第0.84页=0.84、0.76 0.76和0.66页)。 在制导机的配对解码器中,它的分数为77.4%、39.4%和17.0%,79.2%、35.0%和15.6%(表7)。 两种贪婪的解码器在MATH-500上对同一种适配器的比分相差可达3.0分,这就是为什么本文中的每一对比都是在一个解码器内对的.

blocks.en: Comparison with d1. In d1’s own evaluation (512 tokens, 256 steps, d1’s prompt and parser) it scores 80.1% against 79.0% for Instruct ( p = 0.34 p=0.34 ). A second run of the same recipe and seed scored 81.1% in that evaluation ( p = 0.058 p=0.058 ), and the two runs differ on 195 problems with no net direction ( p = 0.39 p=0.39 ). d1’s authors released no LLaDA checkpoint. The public third-party adapter dLLM-data-selection/LlaDA-8B-Instruct-grpo-gsm8k-pass-rate-step-1000 (diffu-GRPO, 1,000 steps) scores 78.8%, 36.0% and 15.2% in our evaluation.
blocks.zh: 与d1比较. 在D1自己的评价(512个令牌,256个步骤,d1的快取和解析器)中,它得分80.1%,而Istruct(p=0.34 p=0.34 )为79.0%。 同一食谱和种子的第二次评分为81.1%(p=0.058 p=0.058 ) , 而两次评分在195个问题上存在差异,没有净取向(p=0.39 p=0.39 ))。 d1的作者没有释放LLADA检查站。 公共第三方适配器dLLLM-data-selection/LlaDA-8B-Instruct-grpo-gsm8k-ass-rate-step-1000(diffu-GRPO,1000步)在我们的评价中得分为78.8%,36.0%和15.2%.

blocks.en: Reward. Re-grading the samples generated during training, d1’s exact-string correctness rose from 24% to 71% of samples over training while our numeric grader rose from 76% to 79%, so much of the reward increase reflects the answer format that d1’s reward and parser require.
blocks.zh: 报恩. D1的准确正确度从24 % 升至71%, 而我们的数字分数从76%升至79%,

blocks.en: Verifiers. Its verifiers repeat the Instruct recipes on its own decodes (82.3% of the GSM8K samples correct, held-out pair accuracy 0.833 and 0.885 with the second epoch kept, final-state pair accuracy 0.881 on the test pools, and for MBPP 35.8% passing with 0.822 and 0.844).
blocks.zh: 验出者. 其核查员在自己的解码上重复了指示食谱(占GSM8K样本的82.3%正确,持有的对数精度为0.833和0.885,第二纪保存,测试池上最终状态对数精度为0.881;MBPP35.8%通过时为0.822和0.844)。

blocks.en: Results. Table 7 runs every method of Table 1 on this generator. Against Instruct’s greedy decoding, its greedy decoding differs by − 1.8 -1.8 , + 4.4 +4.4 , + 1.4 +1.4 , − 3.0 -3.0 and + 2.2 +2.2 points on the five benchmarks (McNemar p = 0.15 p=0.15 , 0.025 0.025 , 0.57 0.57 , 0.23 0.23 and 0.14 0.14 ). SR-SMC and Prism move it by about as much as they move Instruct. With the same method on both generators, the only significant differences are SR-SMC on MATH-500 ( − 4.0 -4.0 , p = 0.0495 p=0.0495 ) and MBPP ( + 3.6 +3.6 , p = 0.047 p=0.047 ) and best-of-4 on Countdown ( + 6.6 +6.6 , p = 0.019 p=0.019 ).
blocks.zh: 结果。 表7在这一生成器上运行表1的每一种方法。 与其贪婪的解码不同,其贪婪的解码在五个基准(McNemar p=0.15 p=0.15 , 0.025 0.025 , 0.57 0.57, 0.23 0.23 0.23 和 0.14 0.14)上的分数相差甚远。 SR-SMC和Prism在移动指令时,会移动它。 两台发电机采用相同的方法,唯一的显著差异是MATH-500上的SR-SMC(− 4.0-4.0,p = 0.0495 p = 0.0495)和MBPP(+ 3.6 + 3.6,p = 0.047 p = 0.047)和倒计时上的最优4(+ 6.6 + 6.6,p = 0.019 p = 0.019).

blocks.en: The Base RL generator applies the same recipe, seed and step count to the untuned LLaDA-8B-Base with two changes that its cold start requires.
blocks.zh: Base RL生成器对未调试的LLaDA-8B-Base应用了同一种配方,种子和步数,并带有其冷起动所需的两个变化.

blocks.en: Prompt prefix. The prompt ends with the <reasoning> prefix that every Base decode in this paper uses (Appendix G ), passed to d1’s trainer as an opening assistant turn so that the rendered prompt is identical to ours. Without the prefix the untuned model does not produce d1’s answer tags and receives no correctness reward.
blocks.zh: 提示前缀 。 提示以每页的 " reasoning " 前缀结尾 本文中的基础解码使用(Appendix G.), 传递给d1的导师作为开口助手转弯, 这样提供的快取和我们的一样. 没有前缀, 未调节的模型不会产生 d1 的答题标签, 也不会得到正确性的奖励 。

blocks.en: Correctness reward. The correctness reward is our numeric grader (the first <answer> block, else a #### line, else the last boxed expression, else the last number, compared numerically) in place of d1’s exact string match, with d1’s four format rewards unchanged. The untuned model writes sentences inside the answer tags, so the exact match rewards 4% of its samples where our grader scores 53% right, and groups of six generations then carry almost no reward variance for the policy gradient to use.
blocks.zh: 正确奖励. 正确性奖励是我们的数字级数(第一个 < 回答 > 区块, 换句话说, 换句话说, 换句话说, 换句话说, 换句话说, 换句话说, 换句话说, 换句话说, 换句话说, 换句话说, D1 的四种格式奖励没有改变 。 未经调整的模型在解答标记中写出句子, 因此精确的匹配奖励了4%的样本, 因为我们的分数是53%的正确, 而六代人组则几乎没有奖励差异 用于政策梯度。

blocks.en: Training. Training took 52 GPU-hours on the same four GPUs, its correctness reward rose from 1.03 to 1.19 of 2, and its completions fill the 256-token canvas because the Base model writes no end token, as in every untuned-Base decode of the paper. The Instruct run keeps d1’s reward.
blocks.zh: 培训。 训练在同一4个GPU上花费了52个GPU小时,其正确性奖励从2分之1.03升至1.19,完成后填补了256个托肯画布,因为"基础"模型没有写出"末端符",如同每张未调试的Base解码纸一样. 指令运行会保留 D1 的奖励 。

blocks.en: Results. The Base RL generator’s greedy accuracy stays at the untuned level, 29.7% against 29.3% averaged over the five benchmarks and 61.7% against 61.8% on GSM8K (199 problems gained and 200 lost), with + 5.0 +5.0 on Countdown ( p = 0.022 p=0.022 ), + 4.3 +4.3 on HumanEval ( p = 0.09 p=0.09 ), − 2.6 -2.6 on MATH-500 and − 4.2 -4.2 on MBPP ( p = 0.022 p=0.022 ), and 5.6 points below one GPU-hour of GSM8K SFT on average (Table 7 ).
blocks.zh: 结果。 Base RL生成器的贪婪精度维持在未调节的水平上,5个基准平均为29.7%,GSM8K平均为61.8%(199个问题得到,200个损失),倒计时时为+ 5.0+ 5.0 (p = 0.022 p = 0.022),人机Eval为+ 4.3+4.3 (p = 0.09 p = 0.09),MATH-500为 2.6-2.6,MBPP为 4.2-4.2 (p = 0.022 p = 0.022),平均低于一个GSM8K SFT的GPU-小时5.6分(表7)。

blocks.en: Verifiers. Its verifiers repeat the recipes of this appendix on its own decodes (65.1% of the GSM8K samples correct, held-out pair accuracy 0.938 and 0.949, final-state pair accuracy 0.927 on the test pools against 0.919 for the SFT generator’s verifier, and for MBPP 24.4% passing with 0.776 and 0.908).
blocks.zh: 验出者. 其核查员在自己的解码上重复本附录的配方(65.1%的GSM8K样品正确、持有对数准确性为0.938和0.949;测试池上的最终状态对数准确性为0.927;SFT发电机的核查员为0.919;MBPP为24.4%,以0.776和0.908通过)。

blocks.en: Guidance. With guidance it gains 14.5 points on GSM8K, 16.0 on Countdown, 4.8 on MATH-500 ( p = 0.015 p=0.015 ), 9.6 on MBPP and 3.0 on HumanEval ( p = 0.06 p=0.06 ), its GSM8K guidance is 4.5 points above the SFT verifier’s guidance of the untuned generator ( p = 0.0005 p=0.0005 ), and best-of-4 reaches 82.7% on GSM8K, the level of the SFT generator with its verifier (82.2%). The lenient reward function is included with our code.
blocks.zh: 指导. 在GSM8K、倒计时16.0、MATH-500(p=0.015 p=0.015)、MBPP和HumanEval(p=0.06 p=0.06)的指引下,其GSM8K的指引比SFT验证器对未调节发电机的指引高4.5分(p=0.0005 p=0.0005),而最佳-4在GSM8K上达到82.7%,这是SFT生成器及其验证器的水平(82.2%)。 我们的代码中包含了宽大奖励功能。

blocks.en: Table 8: Code benchmarks with the GSM8K-trained and the MBPP-trained verifier. The two verifiers of a generator differ only in their training decodes, and Table 1 reports the MBPP verifier in its code columns. Pair is the within-problem accuracy of ranking a passing finished sample above a failing one. ∗ Verified by the verifiers of the SFT generator.
blocks.zh: 表8:经过GSM8K培训的编码基准和经过MBPP培训的验证标准。 发电机的两个核查员只在训练解码方面有所不同,表1在其编码栏中报告了MBPP核查员的情况。 平价是将经过的成品样本排在失败样本之上的内在问题准确性。 * 由SFT生成器的核查员核实。

blocks.en: Each generator’s code verifier repeats the recipe of its GSM8K verifier on four samples at temperature 0.7 for each of the 464 MBPP training and validation problems. Sixty-four problems are held out, and the epoch with the higher held-out pair accuracy is kept (0.918, 0.909 and 0.953 for the SFT generator, Instruct and Dream). On the four-sample test pools of the three generators with their own verifiers, the GSM8K verifiers rank passing above failing programs with pair accuracy 0.759–0.859 and the MBPP verifiers with 0.838–0.944 (Table 8 ). On the untuned generator, whose decodes neither verifier saw in training, the same verifiers reach 0.62–0.78. In guided decoding on MBPP, the MBPP verifier is ahead of the GSM8K verifier for every generator, by 7.4 points for untuned Base, 9.4 for the SFT generator, 2.8 for Instruct and 5.2 for Dream (McNemar p < 10 − 5 p<10^{-5} , p < 10 − 8 p<10^{-8} , p = 0.092 p=0.092 and p = 0.003 p=0.003 ). On HumanEval, which contributes no training data, the differences are smaller, + 1.8 +1.8 points for untuned Base, − 0.6 -0.6 for the SFT generator, + 4.3 +4.3 for Instruct ( p = 0.039 p=0.039 ) and + 3.7 +3.7 for Dream ( p = 0.33 p=0.33 ). blocks.en: For the paired intervention study, we take a 150-problem test subset and save 436 greedy states from the first three blocks. At each state, we compare its original greedy outcome with one regeneration event, namely four alternatives at temperature 0.7, selection against the original by raw verifier score, and then greedy continuation. Each state is tested independently, rather than following the sequential three-event policy. Below score 0.1, success rises from 13.9% to 26.1% on 115 states, with 16 fixes and two regressions. At scores of at least 0.9, it rises from 92.4% to 93.4% on 211 states, with five fixes and three regressions. The threshold 0.5 selects 33.7% of states, whose average gain is 9.5 points, versus 1.7 points for the remaining states. Each state uses one sampled alternative set. Problem-level bootstrap intervals (1,000 resamples) put the gain at threshold 0.5 at 9.5 points [4.2, 15.3].
blocks.zh: 对于配对干预研究,我们取出一个150个问题测试子集,从前三个街区中拯救了436个贪婪的状态. 在每一个州,我们都会将其最初的贪婪结果与一个再生事件进行比较,即在温度0.7时的四种替代品,通过原始核查员分数来选择原始结果,然后是贪婪地继续. 每个州都经过独立测试,而不是遵循相继的"三事件"政策. 下分0.1分,115个邦的成功率从13.9%上升到26.1%,有16个修补和2个回归. 在至少0.9分的分数中,211个邦的分数从92.4%上升到93.4%,有5个修补和3个回归. 阈值0.5选择33.7%的州,其平均得分为9.5分,而其余州则选择1.7分. 每个州都使用一个抽样替代集. 问题级的靴子间隔(1,000个复标)使增益在9.5分的阈值为0.5 [4.2, 15.3].

blocks.en: Zhao et al. (2021) call predictions decision-calibrated for a family of decision rules if, for every rule, the loss the predictions anticipate for the chosen action equals the realized loss. Their predictions concern an outcome that the decision does not change. Here each action leads to a different state, so we predict the outcome of each action separately and require the prediction for the chosen action to match its realized outcome. We consider rules that regenerate when the raw score is below θ \theta . • Predicted success of an action. We apply the greedy-policy Platt map, fitted on development states (Table 9 ), to the raw score of the state the action leads to, which is the current block when continuing and the retained block when regenerating. • Realized success. The outcome of the greedy continuation after that action. Table 10 compares the two on the 436 paired states. • Chosen action. Predicted and realized success differ by at most 2.4 points at every threshold. • Regeneration gain. The predicted gain matches the realized gain. At θ = 0.5 \theta=0.5 the difference is 0.8 points, with interval [ − 4.1 , 5.8 ] [-4.1,5.8] . • Selection. Choosing the best of five candidates by score adds no optimism beyond a shared 2-point offset. After regenerating everywhere, predicted success is 72.1% versus 70.2% realized, and when continuing everywhere it is 67.8% versus 65.8%. The offset reflects the development-fitted map on this test subset, not selection. All intervals are 95% problem-level bootstrap intervals. The test covers one regeneration event per state, with candidates selected by raw score. It does not cover the sequential three-event policy or per-state repair probabilities.
